title: Count Connected Components (DFS)
statement:
Given an N×M binary grid where 1 represents land and 0 represents water, count the number of distinct islands (connected components of 1s).

Two cells are connected if they are adjacent horizontally or vertically.

Use DFS with backtracking to explore each unvisited land cell.
constraints:
1 <= N, M <= 50
Grid cells are 0 or 1.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and M.
The next N lines each contain M space-separated integers (0 or 1).
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of distinct islands.

examples.explanation: Three islands: top-left 2x2, single cell, and bottom-right pair.
Two islands: top-left cluster and bottom-right pair.
